display_long_description:
You are a hired game tester, brought in to playtest an unfinished VR horror game.  
At first, everything seems routine. Then the line between the virtual world and reality begins to blur.
The game starts behaving in ways it shouldn’t. 
[media]
[media]
Strange events become impossible to explain, familiar mechanics stop following the rules, and every step draws you deeper into the unknown.
[media]
[media]
Explore abandoned homes, hidden cellars, sacred shrines, winding forest trails, and long-forgotten temples as you uncover the dark history hidden within the village while surviving terrifying encounters with creatures lurking in the shadows.
[media]
[media]
Will you uncover the truth behind Bamboo Grove, or become part of its forgotten story?
